personal_repos.name: agentic-weather-assistant
personal_repos.description: Full-stack agentic web app: LangChain LLM agent + MCP server wrapping a public REST API. Built with Claude Code.

personal_repos.name: dual-stream-gesture-transformer
personal_repos.description: Real-time hand gesture recognition via a Dual-Stream Spatiotemporal Transformer (DSST) on MediaPipe skeletons. Decouples static pose and motion velocity into two Transformer streams with late fusion. Sim-to-Real training: synthetic pretraining (1,200 sequences) + fine-tuning on 35 real clips across 6 gestures. ~557 FPS on a laptop GPU.

personal_repos.name: High-speed-BLE-RSSI-sampling-rate
personal_repos.description: High-speed BLE RSSI sampling on nRF54L15 (~77 kHz, 3× prior published rates) for wireless sensing applications. Custom Zephyr firmware that bypasses BLE protocol processing for raw energy detection at the radio level.

personal_repos.name: Deep-Learning-for-BLE-Sensing
personal_repos.description: End-to-end super-resolution pipeline recovering wideband LoRa channel responses from narrowband BLE RSSI via progressive sub-pixel convolution and physics-informed loss
